evidenceBoundaries.sourceBasis: Supported HTTP APIs can create a pending order, but expose no order deletion and no reverse status transition that restores the pre-test collection and state.
evidenceBoundaries.ambiguity: For a non-existing order ID, an access-control bypass can reach the business handler and return Order not found, so a generic non-success response plus unchanged snapshots cannot prove invalid-token rejection.
evidenceBoundaries.oracleConstraint: Retain the one-shot response and post-target state for human triage, but do not assert an unsupported exact status or wording and do not count this route as a verified denial.
